questions.question: If x + y = 4 and (1)/(x) + (1)/(y) = (16)/(15) then what is the value of (x³ + y³) ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**We can use the formula 

(x3 + y3) = (x + y) [(x + y)² - 3xy]

Given x + y = 4 and (1)/(x) + (1)/(y) = (16)/(15) 

After solving we get xy = 15/4

Now, From formula, we get 

x3 + y3 = (4) [(4)2 - 3 (15/4)]

x3 + y3 = 4 [16 - 45/4]

x3 + y3 = 4 [19/4] = 19

∴ (x3 + y3) = 19

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x + y = 4

 (1)/(x) + (1)/(y) = (16)/(15)

**Formula used:**

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

(x³ + y³) = (x + y)(x² - xy + y²)

**Calculation:**

** (1)/(x) + (1)/(y) = (16)/(15)**

⇒ (y + x)/xy = 16/15 

⇒ 4/xy = 16/15

⇒ xy = 15/4 (1) 

x + y = 4

By squaring both sides.

x2 + y2 + 2xy = 16 

⇒ x2 + y2 = 16 - 2xy 

⇒ x2 + y2 = 16 - 2 × 15/4 

⇒ x2 + y2 = 16 - 15/2 = 17/2 (2)

∵ (x3 + y3) = (x + y)(x2 - xy + y2)

⇒ (x3 + y3) = 4 × (17/2 - 15/4)

**∴ (x3 + y3) = 19**

Now,

So, Profit = SP - CP = Rs.660 - Rs. 640 

⇒ Rs. 20

The average of 28 numbers is 77. The average of first 14 numbers is 74 and the average of last 15 numbers is 84. If the 14th number is excluded, then what is the average of remaining numbers? (correct to one decimal places)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 28 numbers = 77

Average of first 14 numbers = 74

Average of last 15 numbers = 84 

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of observations ÷ No of observations

**Calculation:**

Value of 14th number = (Sum of first 14 numbers + Sum of last 15 numbers) - Sum of 28 numbers 

⇒ 14th Number = (14 × 74 + 15 × 84 - 28 × 77)

⇒ 1036 + 1260 - 2156 = 140 

Average of remaining 27 numbers = (Sum of 28 numbers - 14th number) ÷ 27 

⇒ (2156 - 140) ÷ 27 = 2016 ÷ 27 

⇒ 74.66 or 74.7

**∴ The required result = 74.7** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Average of 28 numbers = 77

Average of first 14 numbers = 74

Average of last 15 numbers = 84

Deviation on first 14 numbers = 74 - 77 = - 3 × 14 = - 42 

Deviation on last 15 numbers = 84 - 77 = 7 × 15 = 105

14th number = 77 - 42 + 105 = 140

**∴ Average of remaining 27 numbers = (28 × 77 - 140) ÷ 27 = 74.7**

questions.question: To do a certain work, A and B work on alternate days with B beginning the work on the first day. A alone can complete the same work in 24 days. If the work gets completed in 11 (1)/(3) days, then B alone can complete (7)/(9)th part of the original work in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 24 days

A and B work on alternate days with B beginning the work, can complete the work in 11 (1)/(3) days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be 24 units

⇒ Efficiency of A = 24/24 = 1 unit

According to the question,

A works on 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th and (1/3) of 12th day

⇒ A works for 5(1/3) = 16/3 days

⇒ B works for = 11 (1)/(3) - (16)/(3) = (34-16)/(3) = 6 days

⇒ Work done by A in 16/3 days = 16/3 units

Remaining work = 24 - (16/3) = 56/3 units

⇒ 56/3 units are completed by B in 6 days

(7/9)th part of 24 = (24 × 7)/9 = 56/3 units

**∴ B alone will complete (7/9)th of the original work in 6 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

A and B complete the whole task in = 11 (1)/(3) days 

A and B work on alternate days, with B beginning so, we can say B will work only 6 days 

⇒ A will work only 11 (1)/(3) - 6 = 5 (1)/(3) days 

If A's one day work = 1/24 of work A completes in 1 day

⇒ A's 5 (1)/(3) days work = 1/24 × 5 (1)/(3) = 1/24 × 16/3 

⇒ 2/9 

Remaining work = 1 - 2/9 = 7/9 

**∴ B does the 7/9th part of the work in 6 days.**

B, A, B, A, B, A, B, A, B, A, B, A/3

8(x + y)3 - 27(x - y)3 = (5y - x)(Ax2 + By2 + Cxy)

**Formulas used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

(a - b)3 = a3 - b3 - 3ab(a - b)

**Calculation: **

8(x + y)3 - 27(x - y)3 = (5y - x)(Ax2 + By2 + Cxy)

⇒ 8[x³ + y³ + 3xy(x + y)] - 27[x3 - y3 - 3xy(x - y)] = 5Ax²y + 5By³ + 5Cxy² - Ax³ - Bxy² - Cx²y

⇒ - 19x3 + 35y3 + 105x2y - 57xy2 = - Ax3 + 5By3 + 5Ax2y - Cx2y + 5Cxy2 - Bxy2 

By comparing the values of A, B & C in LHS & RHS

⇒ - 19x3 = - Ax3 

∴ A = 19 

⇒ + 35y3 = 5By3

⇒ 35 = 5B 

∴ B = 7

⇒ 105x2y = 5Ax2y - Cx2y

⇒ 105x2y = x2y(5A - C)

⇒ 105 = 5A - C 

⇒ 105 = 5 × 19 - C [A = 19] 

∴ C = - 10 

Now, (A + B - C) = 19 + 7 - (- 10) 

⇒ 26 + 10 = 36 

**∴ The required result = 36**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

Concept Used 

a3 - b3 = (a - b)(a2 + b2 + ab) 

Calculation 

8(x + y)3 - 27(x - y)3 = (5y - x)(Ax2 + By2 + Cxy)

⇒ [2(x + y)]3 - [3(x - y)]3 = (5y - x)(Ax2 + By2 + Cxy)

⇒ We compare above equation with formula 

So, Ax2 = [2(x + y)]2, By2 = [3(x - y)]2, Cxy = 2(x + y) × 3(x - y)

Now, Let the value of x and y be 1 and -1 respectively 

Then , A = 0 , B = 36 and C = 0

A + B - C = 0 + 36 - 0 = 36

∴ The required answer is 36.

questions.question: A shopkeeper earns a profit of 21% after selling a book at 21% discount on the printed price. The ratio of the cost price and selling price of the book is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit percent = 21% 

Discount percent = 21% 

**Formulas used:**

Discount % = Discount/ Printed Price × 100 

Selling Price = Printed price - Discount 

Selling Price - Cost Price = Profit 

Profit % = Profit/Cost price × 100 

**Calculation: **

Let the printed price be = 100

Discount percentage is calculated on printed price. 

Discount % = Discount/ Printed Price × 100 

⇒ 21 = Discount/100 × 100 

⇒ Discount = 21 

Selling Price = Printed price - Discount 

⇒ 100 - 21 = 79 

Profit is calculated on the Cost Price. 

Profit % = Profit/Cost price × 100 

⇒ 21 = (Selling Price - Cost Price)/Cost price × 100 

⇒ 21 = (79 - CP)/ CP × 100 

⇒ 21CP = 7900 - 100CP 

⇒ 121CP = 7900

⇒ CP = 7900/121

**∴ Cost Price/Selling Price = 7900/121 ÷ 79**

**⇒ 100 : 121 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let the Printed Price be 100

Selling Price = Printed Price (100 - Discount%) = (100 - 21)× Printed Price

Selling Price = 79% × Printed Price

Selling Price = (100 + Profit%) × Cost Price 

Selling Price = 121% × Cost Price 

**∴ Cost Price : Selling Price = 100 : 121 **

questions.question: What is the compound interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 8192 for 1 (1)/(4) years at 15% per annum, if interest is compounded 5-monthly ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.8192

Time = 1 (1)/(4) years or 15 months 

Rate = 15% Per annum 

⇒ Rate as per 5-monthly basis = 5/12 × 15 = 25/4% 

**Formulas used:**

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal 

Amount = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Time period = 3 (15 months/5)

Rate as per 5-monthly basis = 5/12 × 15 = 25/4% 

Compound Interest = 8192 × (1 + 25/4 ÷ 100)³ - Principal 

⇒ 8192 × (1 + 1/16)³ - 8192 = 8192 [ 17/16 × 17/16 × 17/16 - 1] 

⇒ 8192 [(4913 - 4096) ÷ 4096] 

⇒ 8192 × 817/4096

⇒ 1634 

**∴ Compound Interest = Rs.1634**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**By Fraction Method 

Rate = 25/4% = 25/4× 100 = 1/16 

CI is calculated on Principal, so it will be the base (100%) for the interest. 

Rate % = Rate/100 = Interest/Principal 

⇒ Interest/Principal = 1/16 

Interest = Amount - Principal 

⇒ Amount = 1 + 16 = 17 

Time Period = 3 (5-monthly) 

=(Principal)/(Amount)=((16)/(17))ⁿ=(16³)/(17³)

⇒ 8192/ Amount = 4096/4913

⇒ So, if 4096 = 8192,

So, Compound Interest (4913 - 4096) = 817; 

⇒ 817 = 817/4096 × 8192 = 1634

**∴ Compound Interest = Rs.1634**

Speed of the current = 3

questions.question: The income of A is 45% more than the income of B and the income of C is 60% less than the sum of the incomes of A and B. The income of D is 20% more than that of C. If the difference between the incomes of B and D is Rs. 13200, then the income (in Rs.) of C is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Income of A is 45% more than the income of B

Income of C is 60% less than the sum of the incomes of A and B

Income of D is 20% more than that of C

The difference between the incomes of B and D is Rs.13200

**Calculation:**

Let the income of B = 100 

⇒ Income of A = 100 × 145/100 = 145

Income of C = (100 + 145) × 40/100 = 98

Income of D = 98 × 120/100 = 117.6

The difference between income of D and B = 117.6 - 100 = 17.6

⇒ 17.6 = Rs.13200 

**∴ Income of C = 13200 × 98/17.6 = Rs.73500**

questions.question: Sides AB and DC of a cyclic quadrilateral ABCD are produced to meet at E and sides AD and BC are produced to meet at F. If ∠ADC = 78° and ∠BEC = 52°, then the measure of ∠AFB is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ADC = 78° and ∠BEC = 52°

**Concept:**

The sum of a pair of opposite angles is 180° of a cyclic quadrilateral. 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ecdc1e4af8b0eea06b16d09b5ef95bddb170d40b5eb76ab11785ff5b6ecda84.png] 

Now, In quadrilateral ABCD,

∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180° (Sum of opposite angles are 180°)

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° - 78° = 102° 

∠EBC = 180° - 102° = 78° [Linear Pair]

In ΔBEC,

∠BEC + ∠EBC + ∠BCE = 180° 

⇒ 52° + 78° + ∠BCE = 180° 

⇒ ∠BCE = 180° - 130° = 50°

⇒ ∠BCE = ∠DCF = 50° (Vertically opposite angle)

∠ADE + ∠FDC = 180° [Linear Pair]

⇒ ∠FDC = 180° - ∠ADE = 180° - 78° = 102°

In ΔDCF,

∠FDC + ∠DCF + ∠DFC = 180° 

102 + 50 + ∠DFC = 180° 

∠DFC = 180° - 152° = 28° 

∠DFC = ∠AFB = 28° 

**∴ The measure of ∠AFB is 28°.**
